title: Lab 2C part 2 — SNS fan-out
topic: SNS pub/sub, fan-out, SNS→SQS, EventBridge→SNS, CloudWatch alarm actions, email subscription confirmation, FIFO topics
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-14-sns-fanout.md and night-14-lab-sns-setup scripts. Answer without peeking at night-14-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Iceland batch exits 1 after an S3 permission error. Night 13 SQS completion queue only receives exit code 0 events. Ops wants email and a ticketing SQS queue notified from the same failure event without each channel polling a shared work queue. What service fits?

options.A: Amazon SQS FIFO — strict ordering ensures email and ticketing receive failures in sequence
options.B: AWS Step Functions — Catch state on the Iceland container routes failures to two queues
options.C: Amazon SNS topic with email and SQS subscriptions — one publish fans out to all subscribers
options.D: Amazon EventBridge archive — replays failed ECS events to subscribers on a schedule

questions.question: night-14-lab-sns-setup subscribes saa-study-gsa-iceland-alerts-inbox to the alerts topic. Messages never arrive in the inbox after sns:Publish succeeds. Subscription shows Confirmed. What is the most likely missing piece?

options.A: SQS queue policy allowing sns.amazonaws.com sqs:SendMessage with aws:SourceArn matching the topic ARN
options.B: IAM user policy granting sqs:ReceiveMessage to the SNS service principal on the inbox queue
options.C: EventBridge input transformer mapping SNS Message to SQS MessageBody before delivery
options.D: FIFO topic suffix .fifo required whenever SNS targets any SQS standard queue subscriber

questions.question: You subscribe an email endpoint to an SNS topic for Iceland failure alerts. aws sns list-subscriptions-by-topic shows SubscriptionArn PendingConfirmation. What must happen before email delivery?

options.A: Attach an IAM role to the topic so SES can assume it and send on behalf of SNS
options.B: The recipient confirms the subscription via the link AWS emailed to that address
options.C: Enable SNS delivery status logging to S3 — confirmation is automatic after first publish
options.D: Convert the subscription protocol from email to email-json using a second subscribe call

questions.question: Night 12 CloudWatch alarm saa-study-gsa-iceland-task-failed watches FailedInvocations on the schedule rule. Night 14 adds the same SNS topic as an alarm action. What does this alarm detect?

options.A: Iceland container exit code 1 after the task stops in the cluster
options.B: SQS completion queue depth exceeding one message for more than five minutes
options.C: NAT Gateway bandwidth saturation in the Night 9 private subnets during RunTask
options.D: EventBridge could not invoke the ECS RunTask target — infra/config failure on the rule

questions.question: An exam scenario needs three internal teams each with its own durable queue receiving every order-placed event from a single checkout service. Producers should not know team queue URLs. Best pattern?

options.A: One SQS standard queue — all three teams share ReceiveMessage on the same URL
options.B: Three Lambda functions polling one DynamoDB stream shard in round-robin
options.C: SNS topic publish from checkout; three SQS queue subscriptions — classic fan-out
options.D: EventBridge custom bus with one rule per team and identical event patterns in series

questions.question: night-14-lab-sns-setup creates EventBridge rule saa-study-gsa-iceland-failure-to-sns targeting SNS. FailedInvocations metric increments on that rule. Topic policy and rule pattern look correct. What is the usual fix?

options.A: SNS topic policy allowing events.amazonaws.com sns:Publish with aws:SourceArn equal to the rule ARN
options.B: Subscribe EventBridge as an HTTPS endpoint on the topic before put-targets will succeed
options.C: Enable SNS server-side encryption with a CMK that trusts the default event bus only
options.D: Change the SNS topic to FIFO — EventBridge cannot target standard SNS topics

questions.question: A mobile app needs push notifications to millions of devices with platform-specific payloads (APNS, FCM). The backend publishes one logical event per user action. Which SNS capability is most relevant?

options.A: SNS mobile push endpoints with platform application ARNs — fan-out to device tokens
options.B: SNS email-json protocol only — mobile devices poll the topic over HTTPS
options.C: SQS long polling from the mobile client — SNS is not used for push delivery
options.D: EventBridge Scheduler one-off schedules — replaces SNS for per-device delivery timing

questions.question: You need strict ordering and deduplication of trade-execution alerts delivered to multiple FIFO SQS queues. Which SNS topic type should you create?

options.A: Standard SNS topic with raw message delivery enabled on all subscriptions
options.B: FIFO SNS topic (name ends in .fifo) with deduplication — pairs with FIFO queue subs
options.C: Standard SNS topic with message filtering on the subscription filter policy only
options.D: SNS topic in another Region — cross-Region FIFO ordering is automatic for finance

questions.question: Night 13 completion consumer and Night 14 SNS inbox both need Iceland pipeline signals. Success should buffer for a slow stats worker; failures should push to ops immediately. How should you split services?

options.A: Single SNS topic for both success and failure — all subscribers get every message
options.B: Replace both with one EventBridge rule targeting five Lambda functions directly
options.C: SQS for success path (pull/worker buffer); SNS for failure path (push fan-out alerts)
options.D: SNS for success only — SQS cannot receive EventBridge ECS Task State Change events

questions.question: An SNS subscription uses a filter policy so only messages with attribute severity=critical reach a PagerDuty HTTPS endpoint. Non-critical publishes still succeed. What happens to filtered-out messages for that subscription?

options.A: SNS delivers them to the DLQ configured on the topic for all rejected filter matches
options.B: SNS retries the HTTPS endpoint until the filter policy is updated to allow them
options.C: Messages are rerouted to the default EventBridge bus for manual replay
options.D: That subscription simply does not receive them — other subscribers still get the publish

questions.question: Raw message delivery is enabled on an SNS→SQS subscription. What does the SQS message body contain compared to the default SNS wrapping?

options.A: Base64-encoded gzip of the payload plus mandatory MessageId and TopicArn attributes
options.B: Only the published message payload — no SNS metadata JSON envelope around it
options.C: The ECS Task State Change event only — SNS strips custom publish bodies entirely
options.D: An empty body — raw delivery requires MessageAttributes on every publish call

questions.question: A Lambda function is subscribed directly to an SNS topic (not via SQS). The function times out on some invocations. What is SNS default behavior?

options.A: SNS retries delivery to Lambda with backoff; configure DLQ on the subscription for poison messages
options.B: SNS immediately deletes the message — Lambda must poll an SQS DLQ separately
options.C: SNS pauses all topic publishes globally until the Lambda concurrency limit is raised
options.D: SNS converts the subscription to email-json after three Lambda timeouts automatically

questions.question: Compared to Night 13 SQS completion queue, why is SNS the wrong choice for the stats-uploader worker pool that processes one message at a time with back-pressure?

options.A: SNS cannot deliver to Lambda — only SQS supports Lambda event source mappings
options.B: SNS is Regional and cannot be used in us-east-1 with ECS Fargate tasks
options.C: SNS push fan-out does not buffer work for competing consumers — use SQS pull model
options.D: SNS requires email confirmation before any programmatic subscriber can be added

questions.question: Cross-account Account B must publish to Account A SNS topic saa-study-gsa-iceland-alerts. What two controls are typically required?

options.A: VPC peering between accounts; SNS messages cannot cross account boundaries otherwise
options.B: SNS topic in Account B only — cross-account publish is not supported for standard topics
options.C: AWS Organizations SCP denying all SNS in B — cross-account requires Control Tower enrollment
options.D: Topic policy on A allowing B principal sns:Publish; IAM on B allowing sns:Publish to topic ARN

questions.question: After Night 14 teardown, you want Iceland success events on SQS and failure alerts on SNS again. Minimum lab scripts to re-deploy both paths?

options.A: night-14-lab-sns-setup only — it recreates the Night 13 completion queue automatically
options.B: night-13-lab-sqs-setup then night-14-lab-sns-setup — success queue and failure fan-out are separate
options.C: night-12-lab-eventbridge-schedule only — schedule rule includes SQS and SNS targets
options.D: night-14-lab-sns-inbox only — inbox script creates the topic and failure rule on first run
